permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  auth-expiry-diagnostic:
    name: CI017 auth expiry diagnostic
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: web
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 26
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: web/package-lock.json
      - name: Install exact web dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Prepare the same Japanese browser fonts
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y fontconfig fonts-noto-cjk=1:20230817+repack1-3
          fc-list -q ':lang=ja'
          test -x /usr/bin/google-chrome
      - name: Run one CI017 diagnostic attempt
        env:
          AUTOSTREAM_BROWSER_PATH: /usr/bin/google-chrome
          AUTOSTREAM_CI017_DIAGNOSTIC: "1"
          AUTOSTREAM_CI017_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/ci017-auth-expiry

          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

on:

    branches: ["codex/node-selection-sharing-20261106-01"]
  workflow_dispatch:

  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: node-sharing-validation-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

  shared-node-regressions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      GOMAXPROCS: "2"
      AUTOSTREAM_MARIADB_TEST_DSN: root:node-sharing-ci-root@tcp(127.0.0.1:3306)/autostream_ci?parseTime=true

      mariadb:

        env:
          MARIADB_DATABASE: autostream_ci
          MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: node-sharing-ci-root
        ports:
          - 3306:3306
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "healthcheck.sh --connect --innodb_initialized"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: go.mod
      - name: Check changed Go formatting
        id: goformat
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mapfile -t files < <(git diff --name-only f7a086b993cfc242a31a21c0a975eff0e3939de8 -- '*.go')
          if (( ${#files[@]} > 0 )); then
            fmt_status=0
            diff="$(gofmt -d "${files[@]}")" || fmt_status=$?
            printf '%s\n' "$diff"
            if [[ -n "$diff" || "$fmt_status" -ne 0 ]]; then
              exit 1
            fi

      - name: Run real Memory and MariaDB selection and ownership regressions

        shell: bash

          set -euo pipefail

            -run '^Test((Memory|MariaDB)(SharedNodeSelections|SelectedStartClaims|ArchiveRunSource|ExplicitNodeSelection|VCWaitingCreateRevalidatesProfileAndCurrentSnapshot|ArchiveAuthorityRequiresExactV2Report)|DiscordWaitingCredential)' \

          go test -timeout 5m -p 1 ./internal/database -run '^TestMariaDB(NodeSelection|ControlPlatformFeatureMigrationAndPersistence)' -count=1 -json | tee "${RUNNER_TEMP}/node-sharing-migrations.json"
      - name: Run HTTP save and refresh regression

-- Keep this migration resumable across MariaDB's independently committed DDL.
-- The migration runner records the migration only after every statement succeeds.
-- A process interruption after the first ALTER must therefore be safe to replay.
ALTER TABLE media_assets
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS client_operation_id VARCHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL AFTER upload_session_id,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS client_operation_session_id VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL AFTER client_operation_id,
  ADD UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_media_upload_operation (client_operation_session_id, client_operation_id);

-- MODIFY to the same definition is safe to replay after a partial application.
-- Preserve complete ordinary filenames across save/reload; no existing row is removed.
ALTER TABLE stream_video_cover_candidates MODIFY COLUMN display_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE stream_settings
  MODIFY COLUMN updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL;

-- Saved choices are independent from the single current execution owner.
-- Existing execution, stop, and archive owners are deliberately left intact.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stream_node_selections (
  stream_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  service_type ENUM('discord_bot','encoder_recorder','worker') NOT NULL,
  service_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (stream_id, service_type),
  KEY idx_stream_node_selection_service (service_id, stream_id)
);

-- A duplicate primary role fails rather than arbitrarily choosing a Node.
-- NOT EXISTS makes a retry after an interrupted migration record harmless.
INSERT INTO stream_node_selections
  (stream_id, service_type, service_id, created_at, updated_at)
SELECT a.stream_id, a.service_type, a.service_id, a.assigned_at, a.assigned_at
FROM stream_service_assignments a
JOIN streams s ON s.id = a.stream_id
WHERE a.assignment_role = 'primary'
  AND a.service_type IN ('discord_bot','encoder_recorder','worker')
  AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM stream_node_selections existing
    WHERE existing.stream_id = a.stream_id
      AND existing.service_type = a.service_type
  );

-- Older frames can name their Bot through an authentication profile without
-- having materialized a runtime assignment yet. Preserve that saved choice too.
INSERT INTO stream_node_selections
  (stream_id, service_type, service_id, created_at, updated_at)
SELECT s.id, 'discord_bot', bot.service_id, s.created_at, COALESCE(ss.updated_at, s.created_at)
FROM streams s
JOIN stream_settings ss ON ss.stream_id = s.id
JOIN profiles p ON p.id = ss.discord_config_id AND p.kind = 'discord_config'
JOIN services bot
  ON bot.service_id = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.config, '$.service_id'))
  AND bot.service_type = 'discord_bot'
WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM stream_node_selections existing
    WHERE existing.stream_id = s.id AND existing.service_type = 'discord_bot'
  );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stream_archive_run_sources (
  stream_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,

  archive_started_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  service_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

  PRIMARY KEY (stream_id, archive_run_id, archive_started_at),
  UNIQUE KEY uniq_stream_archive_run_source (stream_id, archive_run_id),
  INDEX idx_stream_archive_run_source_service (service_id, stream_id)
);

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
cd "${root}"
evidence="${RUNNER_TEMP:?}/polling-create-upload-sql-evidence"
mkdir -p "${evidence}"
case "${1:?http or browser mode required}" in
  http)
    # The UI188 stage grants the existing disposable autostream077_claim_
    # schema prefix to the application user; each SQL parent creates its own DB.
    mapfile -t required < <(python3 -B scripts/ci/verify-polling-create-upload-evidence.py sql-http)
    [[ "${#required[@]}" -gt 0 ]]
    pattern="^($(IFS='|'; echo "${required[*]}"))$"
    mapfile -t discovered < <(
      go test -mod=readonly -p 1 ./internal/httpapi -list "${pattern}" |
        LC_ALL=C grep '^Test' | LC_ALL=C sort
    )
    if [[ "$(printf '%s\n' "${discovered[@]}")" != "$(printf '%s\n' "${required[@]}" | LC_ALL=C sort)" ]]; then
      echo "Polling SQL parent discovery differs from the exact required inventory" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    result="${evidence}/http-parents.json"
    test ! -e "${result}"
    go test -mod=readonly -p 1 ./internal/httpapi -run "${pattern}" -count=1 -timeout=8m -json | tee "${result}"
    required_json="$(printf '%s\n' "${required[@]}" | jq -R . | jq -cs .)"
    jq -s -e --arg package github.com/example/autostream-control-panel/internal/httpapi --argjson required "${required_json}" \
      '. as $events |
        ([$events[] | select(.Action=="skip" or .Action=="fail")]|length)==0 and
        ([$events[] | select(.Package==$package and .Action=="pass" and ((.Test // "")==""))]|length)==1 and
        all($required[]; . as $name |
          ([$events[] | select(.Package==$package and .Test==$name and .Action=="run")]|length)==1 and
          ([$events[] | select(.Package==$package and .Test==$name and .Action=="pass")]|length)==1)' \
      "${result}" >/dev/null
    ;;
  browser)
    [[ "${AUTOSTREAM_SQL_UI_BROWSER:-}" == 1 ]]
    test -n "${AUTOSTREAM_MARIADB_TEST_DSN:?isolated MariaDB fixture DSN required}"
    mkdir -p "${evidence}/browser"
    result="${evidence}/actual-browser-go.json"
    test ! -e "${result}"
    go test -mod=readonly -p 1 ./internal/httpapi -run '^TestPollingActualUIHTTPMariaDBCreateAndUploadRecovery$' -count=1 -timeout=9m -json | tee "${result}"
    jq -s -e \
      --arg package github.com/example/autostream-control-panel/internal/httpapi \
      --arg name TestPollingActualUIHTTPMariaDBCreateAndUploadRecovery \
      '. as $events |
        ([$events[] | select(.Action=="skip" or .Action=="fail")]|length)==0 and
        ([$events[] | select(.Package==$package and .Action=="pass" and ((.Test // "")==""))]|length)==1 and
        ([$events[] | select(.Package==$package and .Test==$name and .Action=="run")]|length)==1 and
        ([$events[] | select(.Package==$package and .Test==$name and .Action=="pass")]|length)==1' \
      "${result}" >/dev/null
    jq -e '.status=="PASS_REAL_UI_HTTP_SQL_FIXTURE" and .backend=="SQL"' "${evidence}/browser/receipt.json" >/dev/null
    jq -e '.status=="PASS_REAL_UI_HANDLER_SQL_STATE"' "${evidence}/browser/handler-state.json" >/dev/null
    ;;
  *) echo "unknown finite MariaDB evidence mode" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

"""Materialize and verify the immutable UI188 CP fixture outside the product tree."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys


def materialize(root: Path, destination: Path) -> dict:
    root = root.resolve()
    destination = destination.resolve()
    if destination == root or destination.is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError("Historical fixture must be outside the current product tree")
    if destination.exists():
        raise ValueError("Historical fixture destination already exists")
    harness = root / "scripts/ci/ui188-full-e2e"
    sys.path.insert(0, str(harness))
    from source import HISTORICAL_MANIFEST_SHA256, cp_test_rows, unique_json, verify

    manifest_raw = (harness / "product-files.json").read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(manifest_raw).hexdigest() != HISTORICAL_MANIFEST_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("Immutable historical manifest hash changed")
    manifest = unique_json(manifest_raw)
    lock = unique_json((harness / "source-lock.json").read_bytes())
    rows = cp_test_rows(manifest, lock, (harness / "cp-test-overlay.json").read_bytes())
    destination.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    for row in rows:
        if row["mode"] not in ("100644", "100755"):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported historical CP source mode")
        target = destination / row["path"]
        if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(destination):
            raise ValueError("Historical source path escapes its fixture")
        data = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(root), "cat-file", "blob", row["oid"]])
        if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != row["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Historical source blob hash mismatch")
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(data)
        target.chmod(0o755 if row["mode"] == "100755" else 0o644)

    # The harness is separate from the immutable product. Refuse any overlap
    # rather than replacing a historical product row with current source.
    historical_harness = destination / "scripts/ci/ui188-full-e2e"
    if historical_harness.exists():
        raise ValueError("Historical product overlaps the preflight harness")
    shutil.copytree(harness, historical_harness, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))
    verified = verify(destination, "cp")
    if verified != len(rows):
        raise ValueError("Historical source verification denominator changed")
    return {
        "historical_paths_verified": verified,
        "historical_product_tree": lock["components"]["cp"]["verified_tree"],
        "current_product_modified": False,
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--destination", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(materialize(args.root, args.destination), sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Require the fixed polling/create/upload inventory and actual positive events."""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shlex

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
MANIFEST = Path(__file__).with_name("polling-create-upload-inventory.json")
SQL_PARENT_COUNTS = {"http_parents": 6, "store_parents": 5, "database_parents": 1, "browser_parents": 1}


def require(condition, reason):
    if not condition:
        raise SystemExit(reason)


def inventory():
    data = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    require(data["schema_version"] == 1, "unsupported evidence inventory")
    for key in ("unit", "live_cover", "media_browser", "related_browser"):
        scope = data[key]
        require(scope["expected_count"] == len(scope["names"]) > 0, key + " denominator mismatch")
        require(len(set(scope["names"])) == len(scope["names"]), key + " duplicate names")
        require(all(isinstance(name, str) and name and "\n" not in name for name in scope["names"]), key + " invalid name")
    sql = data.get("sql")
    require(isinstance(sql, dict) and set(sql) == set(SQL_PARENT_COUNTS), "SQL parent families differ from the fixed inventory")
    sql_names = []
    for family, count in SQL_PARENT_COUNTS.items():
        parents = sql[family]
        require(isinstance(parents, list) and len(parents) == count > 0, family + " denominator mismatch")
        require(all(isinstance(name, str) and name and name == name.strip() and "\n" not in name and "\r" not in name for name in parents), family + " invalid parent name")
        require(len(set(parents)) == count, family + " duplicate parent names")
        sql_names.extend(parents)
    require(len(sql_names) == len(set(sql_names)) == 13, "SQL parents overlap across families")
    expected_paths = set(data["unit"]["entries"] + data["unit"]["transitive_test_files"] + data["live_cover"]["entries"] + data["media_browser"]["entries"])
    observed_paths = {path.relative_to(ROOT / "web").as_posix() for pattern in data["test_path_patterns"] for path in (ROOT / "web/tests").glob(pattern)}
    require(expected_paths == observed_paths, "polling/create/upload test path inventory changed; review its exact manifest")
    for path in expected_paths | {data["related_browser"]["entry"], *data["related_browser"]["case_sources"]}:
        require((ROOT / "web" / path).is_file(), "required evidence source is missing")
    expected_command = ["node", "--no-warnings", "--test", "--test-reporter=spec", "--test-concurrency=1", "--test-timeout=30000", *data["unit"]["entries"]]
    package = json.loads((ROOT / "web/package.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    require(shlex.split(package["scripts"]["test:polling-create-upload"]) == expected_command, "unit command differs from its fixed path inventory")
    return data


def verify_spec(data, scope, path):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    require(len(raw) <= 50 * 1024 * 1024, "oversized test output")
    text = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*m", "", raw.decode("utf-8"))
    expected = data[scope]
    summaries = {}
    for key in ("tests", "suites", "pass", "fail", "cancelled", "skipped", "todo"):
        values = re.findall(r"^\s*ℹ " + key + r" ([0-9]+)\s*$", text, re.M)
        require(len(values) == 1, "missing or duplicate " + key + " summary")
        summaries[key] = int(values[0])
    require(summaries["tests"] == summaries["pass"] == expected["expected_count"], "actual test denominator differs from the fixed inventory")
    require(all(summaries[key] == 0 for key in ("fail", "cancelled", "skipped", "todo")), "non-positive test result")
    names = re.findall(r"^\s*✔ (.+) \([0-9.]+ms\)\s*$", text, re.M)
    require(Counter(names) == Counter(expected["names"]), "actual positive named-test inventory differs")
    result = {"scope": scope, "status": "PASS", "summary": summaries, "positive_names": names, "input_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
    if scope == "media_browser":
        receipts = []
        for condition in ("ja-light-1440", "en-dark-390"):
            directory = path.parent / "media-upload" / condition
            receipt_raw = (directory / "receipt.json").read_bytes()
            value = json.loads(receipt_raw)
            require(value["status"] == "PASS_ACTUAL_UI_SYNTHETIC_API_FIXTURE" and value["condition"]["id"] == condition and value["create_count"] == 1, "P3 actual UI receipt missing")
            require(value["browser"].get("product", "").startswith("Chrome/"), "P3 actual Chrome version missing")
            require(any(directory.glob("*.png")), "P3 browser screenshots missing")
            receipts.append({"condition": condition, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(receipt_raw).hexdigest(), "browser": value["browser"]})
        require(len(list((path.parent / "media-upload/late-generation").glob("*new-generation-after-old-response.png"))) == 1, "P3 late-generation screenshot missing")
        result["browser_receipts"] = receipts
    return result


def verify_related(data, path):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    require(len(raw) <= 50 * 1024 * 1024, "oversized browser receipt")
    value = json.loads(raw)
    expected = data["related_browser"]
    require(value["status"] == "PASS_RELATED_ACTUAL_NEXT_UI_FIXTURE", "related browser did not finish positively")
    require(value["expected_cases"] == expected["expected_count"], "related browser denominator changed")
    require(value["counts"] == {"passed": expected["expected_count"], "failed": 0, "not_run": 0, "skipped": 0, "cancelled": 0}, "related browser has non-positive cases")
    require(Counter(case["name"] for case in value["cases"]) == Counter(expected["names"]), "related browser named inventory changed")
    require(all(case["status"] == "PASS" for case in value["cases"]), "related browser case did not pass")
    require(value["source_before"] == value["source_after"], "product source changed during browser proof")
    require(isinstance(value["browser"], dict) and value["browser"].get("product", "").startswith("Chrome/"), "actual Chrome version receipt is missing")
    return {"scope": "related_browser", "status": "PASS", "counts": value["counts"], "positive_names": [case["name"] for case in value["cases"]], "browser": value["browser"], "input_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("inventory", "sql-http", "sql-store", "spec", "related"))
    parser.add_argument("--scope", choices=("unit", "live_cover", "media_browser"))
    parser.add_argument("--input", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    data = inventory()
    if args.mode == "inventory":
        print(json.dumps({"status": "FIXED_INVENTORY_VALID", "counts": {key: data[key]["expected_count"] for key in ("unit", "live_cover", "media_browser", "related_browser")}}))
        return
    if args.mode == "sql-http":
        parents = data["sql"]["http_parents"]
        require(len(parents) > 0 and len(parents) == len(set(parents)), "invalid SQL HTTP parent inventory")
        print("\n".join(parents))
        return
    if args.mode == "sql-store":
        print(json.dumps({"status": "VALIDATED_SQL_PARENT_INVENTORY", "family_counts": SQL_PARENT_COUNTS, "total": 13,
                          "inventory_sha256": hashlib.sha256(MANIFEST.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "parents": data["sql"]["store_parents"]}))
        return
    require(args.input is not None and args.output is not None, "input and a fresh output path are required")
    if args.mode == "spec":
        require(args.scope is not None, "spec scope is required")
        result = verify_spec(data, args.scope, args.input)
    else:
        result = verify_related(data, args.input)
    result["inventory_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(MANIFEST.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    with args.output.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        json.dump(result, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({"scope": result["scope"], "status": "PASS", "positive_names": len(result["positive_names"])}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
